"Nemesis Carrier Repulsion Trials":
"In these Trials, a Nemesis Carrier appears and begins dropping enemies onto the battlefield.

To make progress towards repelling the Nemesis Carrier, you must first defeat enemies within the landing zone. Once enough enemies have been defeated, a high-level enemy will appear. Defeating this enemy will clear the Trial."

"During this Trial, the Nemesis Carrier will drop a Homing Punisher into the landing zone.

The Homing Punisher will detonate after a short time, dealing damage to nearby players. However, if you can hit it with a Dive Attack before it detonates, it will deal a high amount of damage to the enemies instead."
